name: pr-review-queue
description: Shows the pull request review queue for the repositories you name (owner/repo, up to 5): which open pull requests have gone quiet, who each one is waiting on (a reviewer, the author, failing checks or a merge conflict), and the review load per person (open requests, oldest wait, reviews done, overloaded or idle). Staleness, blockers, priority and load are computed in code from the code host, never guessed. After you approve the exact text it posts one nudge comment on one stale pull request. On demand in chat; it never merges, approves, closes, labels, assigns or edits a pull request.

skills.name: PR review queue
skills.description: Stale pull requests in priority order, what each is blocked by (reviewer, author, failing checks, merge conflict) and the review load per person; then a nudge comment on a stale pull request, posted only after you approve the exact text.
examples: What PRs are stuck in acme/shop?
Who is overloaded with reviews in acme/api?
